canonicalCloudflareAccessContract.subjectRequirement: non-empty string, immutable Cloudflare Access subject
canonicalCloudflareAccessContract.superadminRegistryRequirement: present in frozen PRODUCTION_OPERATIONAL_SUPERADMIN_REGISTRY with subject and email matching

CLOUDFLARE_ACCESS_TEAM_DOMAIN.name: CLOUDFLARE_ACCESS_TEAM_DOMAIN
CLOUDFLARE_ACCESS_TEAM_DOMAIN.formatRequirement: HTTPS origin ending strictly in .cloudflareaccess.com, alphanumeric subdomain with hyphens, no path/query/fragment/auth

CLOUDFLARE_ACCESS_AUD.name: CLOUDFLARE_ACCESS_AUD
CLOUDFLARE_ACCESS_AUD.formatRequirement: Non-empty string <= 256 characters, no leading/trailing whitespace, exact match against JWT aud claim
CLOUDFLARE_ACCESS_AUD.exampleFormat: 64-character hexadecimal tag generated by Cloudflare Zero Trust upon application creation

accessApplicationDesign.identityProviderRequirement: Corporate IdP with enforced hardware-backed MFA (FIDO2/WebAuthn), no social logins, no one-time PINs
accessApplicationDesign.jwtAudienceCreationSemantics: Generated uniquely and immutably by Cloudflare Zero Trust upon application creation; copied to Worker env
accessApplicationDesign.issuerRelationship: Derived as normalized HTTPS origin of the Cloudflare Access Team Domain
accessApplicationDesign.accessAssertionForwarding: Passed by Cloudflare Edge in Cf-Access-Jwt-Assertion request header to Worker; validated internally

policyOrdering: Explicit Operational Administrator ALLOW policy (human identity)
Implicit / Default Deny for all other requests
accessPolicyDesign.allowedCriteria: Explicitly enumerated corporate email addresses or dedicated, vetted Access User Group only

futureEntryStructure.expectedEmail: Verified individual operational engineer corporate email

prerequisitesForEnrollment: Confirmed Cloudflare Access user subject and email from verified IdP test session
Cryptographic attestation and hardware token enrollment verification
Formal dual-authorization PR and sign-off by two authorized engineering leads
Independent audit evidence record generated and sealed prior to deployment
removalProcedure: Change status to 'suspended' or remove entry from PRODUCTION_OPERATIONAL_SUPERADMIN_REGISTRY array in worker/auth/cloudflareAccessOperationalAuth.ts
Revoke access in Cloudflare Access policy or IdP group
Deploy updated Worker build to invalidate runtime authorization immediately

cloudflareServiceTokenJwtShape.sub: empty string or machine service token ID

rejectionMechanisms: Payload sub claim must be a non-empty string; empty string fails with OperationalAuthErrorCode.HUMAN_SUBJECT_REQUIRED (401)
Payload email claim must be present and pass isValidEmail; missing/empty email fails with OperationalAuthErrorCode.EMAIL_REQUIRED (401)
Identity must match an entry in PRODUCTION_OPERATIONAL_SUPERADMIN_REGISTRY; unregistered machine identities fail with OperationalAuthErrorCode.SUPERADMIN_NOT_AUTHORIZED (403)

dormantProvisioningInvariants.separationOfConcerns: Infrastructure resource existence in Cloudflare Zero Trust DOES NOT equal ingress readiness or operational route activation

failureModesThreatModel.failureEffect: Traffic routes to tenant application or fails DNS resolution
failureModesThreatModel.failClosedExpectation: Access token validation will not receive correct host, or request hits non-operational route with standard tenant auth (401)
failureModesThreatModel.detection: Audit logs showing DNS 404 or tenant route 401

failureModesThreatModel.failureEffect: Access boundary does not protect the exact Worker operational endpoint
failureModesThreatModel.failClosedExpectation: Worker router exact carve-out returns 404 while dormant, or fails closed if path doesn't match
failureModesThreatModel.detection: Path discrepancy detected in Cloudflare Access configuration audit

failureModesThreatModel.failClosedExpectation: validateCloudflareAccessConfig or jwtVerify rejects token with AUDIENCE_MISMATCH (401)
failureModesThreatModel.rollback: Update CLOUDFLARE_ACCESS_AUD in Worker environment to match application tag

failureModesThreatModel.failureEffect: Token issuer verification fails or JWKS URL invalid
failureModesThreatModel.failClosedExpectation: validateCloudflareAccessConfig rejects with CONFIG_NOT_READY (503) or token rejected with ISSUER_MISMATCH (401)
failureModesThreatModel.detection: Worker safe error log: CONFIG_NOT_READY / ISSUER_MISMATCH
failureModesThreatModel.rollback: Update CLOUDFLARE_ACCESS_TEAM_DOMAIN to match authoritative team origin

failureModesThreatModel.failureEffect: Unintended corporate users receive Access assertion tokens
failureModesThreatModel.failClosedExpectation: Worker rejects user at SUPERADMIN_REGISTRY_EMPTY (403) or SUPERADMIN_NOT_AUTHORIZED (403)
failureModesThreatModel.detection: Cloudflare Access audit logs show non-superadmin users authenticated
failureModesThreatModel.rollback: Delete wildcard rule and replace with explicit individual allow list

failureModesThreatModel.failureEffect: All company domain users pass Access edge
failureModesThreatModel.failClosedExpectation: Worker registry check fails closed with SUPERADMIN_NOT_AUTHORIZED (403)
failureModesThreatModel.detection: Access policy audit shows domain-wide rule
failureModesThreatModel.rollback: Restrict policy to explicit superadmin emails

failureModesThreatModel.failClosedExpectation: Worker rejects token due to missing human email / empty subject (401)
failureModesThreatModel.rollback: Ensure machine tokens are strictly excluded from Access application

failureModesThreatModel.failureEffect: Tenant user attempts operational command with tenant token
failureModesThreatModel.failClosedExpectation: Worker route carve-out does not process tenant tokens; fails with MISSING_TOKEN (401)
failureModesThreatModel.rollback: Tenant token isolation verified; no action needed

failureModesThreatModel.failureEffect: Access token sent to Worker without env config
failureModesThreatModel.failClosedExpectation: Worker fails closed with CONFIG_NOT_READY (503 AUTH_SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE)

failureModesThreatModel.failureEffect: Request arrives without Access protection at edge
failureModesThreatModel.failClosedExpectation: Worker fails closed with MISSING_TOKEN (401 UNAUTHORIZED)
failureModesThreatModel.rollback: Provision Access application before allowing ingress

failureModesThreatModel.failureEffect: Worker cannot retrieve Cloudflare Access public keys
failureModesThreatModel.failClosedExpectation: Remote JWKS resolver fails closed with JWKS_UNAVAILABLE (503 AUTH_SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE)
